description.value: A well-serviced provincial campground 3 km south of Fernie on Highway 3, set in Rocky Mountain forest beside a Lizard Creek waterfall, with showers and potable water on-site and the town's restaurants, trails, and mountain-bike network minutes away. Gates close outside the summer operating season.

address.value: 3 km South of Fernie on Highway 3, Fernie, BC
